input: Compare Brask Ventures and Gravick Partners on stage, cheque size and sector focus.

rounds.answer:
| | Brask Ventures | Gravick Partners |
|---|---|---|
| HQ / geography | Berlin; Germany | Warsaw; Poland |
| Stages | Series A, Series B | Series A |
| Cheque size | €3M–€12M | €2M–€8M |
| Sector focus | Robotics, industrial automation, logistics | Logistics, mobility |

- **Overlap:** Both invest in logistics at Series A, and their cheque ranges overlap between €3M and €8M.
- **Differences:** Brask goes later (Series B) and writes larger cheques. It also focuses on robotics and automation. Gravick is Series A only and adds mobility.
